description: This file serves as the main entry point and UI scaffold for a Flutter implementation of the 2048 game. It contains minimal widget structure including a root widget, a placeholder home screen with score displays, a grid placeholder for the game board, and control buttons. The implementation focuses on establishing the UI framework without game logic.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget that sets up the MaterialApp scaffold with title '2048' and home as a placeholder widget.

classes.name: _PlaceholderHome
classes.description: A stateless widget providing the minimal UI layout with app bar, score badges, game board placeholder, and control buttons.

classes.name: _ScoreBadge
classes.description: A small widget displaying a score label and its value, styled within a decorated container.

classes.name: _BoardPlaceholders
classes.description: A widget rendering a 4x4 grid of bordered containers acting as placeholders for the game board.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Overridden in each widget class to return the respective widget tree, constructing the UI.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point that runs the MyApp widget.
